name: com.ayskilllab/grants
title: AY Grants
description: Free, read-only search of open public grants in the US, the UK and the EU, with deadlines.

tools.name: search_open_grants
tools.description: Grants open now or opening soon, soonest deadline first. Needs at least one of query, applicant, region or closes_within_days: there is no list of everything. Up to 10 rows an answer and 3 pages; 300 rows a day per address. Each row has our page (page_url) and the official notice (official_url).

query.description: Words in the title or the funder's name.

market.description: tw = Taiwan, us = United States, uk = United Kingdom, eu = European Union. Leave it out for this site's own: us, uk, eu.

applicant.description: Who can apply, as the list records it. Taiwan: 個人, 企業, 團體, 學校, 法人, 政府機關, 原住民, 農漁民. Elsewhere: Business, Nonprofits, Education, Government, Tribal, Individuals.

region.description: A Taiwan county or city (market tw) or a UK nation (market uk). Grants open to the whole country count too.

status.description: open (the default) includes grants with no fixed deadline.

closes_within_days.description: Only open grants whose deadline is in this many days.

page.description: Page of results, from 1; ten rows a page.

tools.name: get_grant
tools.description: One grant's page: status, funder, who can apply, place, amount, dates, the official sentences each field was read from, and the expected next round when there is one. A field we could not read is null, which means not confirmed. Counts as one row.

id.description: The id a search returned, such as us-360875, or the page address.

tools.name: upcoming_deadlines
tools.description: Open grants closing in the next days (14 unless you say, 30 at most), soonest first. Up to 10 rows an answer and 3 pages; 300 rows a day per address.

days.description: Deadlines within this many days; 14 unless you say.

market.description: tw = Taiwan, us = United States, uk = United Kingdom, eu = European Union. Leave it out for this site's own: us, uk, eu.

applicant.description: Who can apply, as the list records it. Taiwan: 個人, 企業, 團體, 學校, 法人, 政府機關, 原住民, 農漁民. Elsewhere: Business, Nonprofits, Education, Government, Tribal, Individuals.

region.description: A Taiwan county or city (market tw) or a UK nation (market uk). Grants open to the whole country count too.

page.description: Page of results, from 1; ten rows a page.

tools.name: screen_grants
tools.description: Taiwan grants open now, opening soon or with no fixed deadline, screened by the rules of the free check at https://twgrants.ayskilllab.com/check: who can apply, then the county, then the limits a notice states in so many words (years since founding, capital, employees, the SME standard). Each row says why it is listed, with the notice's sentence, and is one of fits, unconfirmed (the notice doesn't say who or where) or may_not_fit (a stated limit disagrees; it can belong to one sub-item, so read the notice). Leave out what you don't know; it is then not compared. Reasons are in Chinese, as the notices are. Up to 10 rows an answer and 3 pages; 300 rows a day per address.

organisation_type.description: 企業 = company or business, 個人 = individual, 團體 = association or co-operative, 法人 = foundation or incorporated association, 學校 = school, 政府機關 = government body.

county.description: Where the applicant is registered. Grants open to the whole country count too.

capital_twd.description: Paid-in capital in NT$ (元), not 萬.

also.description: Identities some grants are only for: 原住民 (indigenous person or group), 農漁民 (farmer, fisher, farmers' or fishers' association).

include.description: Which results to list; fits_and_unconfirmed unless you say. The counts always cover all three.

page.description: Page of results, from 1; ten rows a page.

tools.name: next_round_forecasts
tools.description: Programmes whose next round is already listed, or can be placed in a month because at least two past rounds opened in it. An estimate says so (basis: estimate) and is not an announcement. Up to 10 rows an answer and 3 pages; 300 rows a day per address.

market.description: tw = Taiwan, us = United States, uk = United Kingdom, eu = European Union. Leave it out for this site's own: us, uk, eu.

query.description: Words in the programme's title or funder.

months_ahead.description: How far ahead to look; 6 unless you say.

basis.description: listed: the next round is already announced; estimate: placed from past rounds.

page.description: Page of results, from 1; ten rows a page.
